people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king; for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do justice.
translations.bsb: When all Israel heard of the judgment the king had given, they stood in awe of him, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to administer justice.
